cmd: mkdir -p out && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -loop 1 -framerate 30 -i in/intro.jpg -i in/intro.wav -filter_complex "[1:a]adelay=800:all=1,apad[a]" -map 0:v -map "[a]" -c:v libx264 -tune stillimage -preset veryfast -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -t 21.40 -movflags +faststart out/intro.mp4 && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -loop 1 -framerate 30 -i in/outro.jpg -i in/outro.wav -filter_complex "[1:a]adelay=800:all=1,apad[a]" -map 0:v -map "[a]" -c:v libx264 -tune stillimage -preset veryfast -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -t 25.70 -movflags +faststart out/outro.mp4
